Cash housing allowance paid to the employee, fully taxable.
Exempt from personal income tax up to the yearly cap per person, the excess is taxable.
Fixed per diem within the internal policy of the company, exempt from personal income tax.
Wedding, bereavement and other support payments exempt from personal income tax.
Housing Paid on Behalf of the Employee
Rent, electricity and water paid by the employer to third parties: not paid out with the net salary, taxable up to 15% of the taxable income.
Overtime - Public Holiday or Paid Leave Day
Additional 30% of the hourly wage for every hour worked between 22:00 and 06:00, normal hours and overtime alike.

Additional 20% of the daytime wage of the day type for the overtime hours worked at night, on top of the overtime and night work pay.
Payment of the Untaken Annual Leave
Exempt from personal income tax from the 2026 tax period.
Statutory severance allowance (Labour Code, Art. 46): half a month of average wage per year of service not covered by unemployment insurance, exempt from personal income tax.
Statutory job-loss allowance (Labour Code, Art. 47): one month of average wage per year of service, at least two months, exempt from personal income tax.
Termination payments above the statutory allowances, taxable.
Compulsory Insurance Base - Unpaid Working Days

The contributions are never prorated: a month with fewer than 14 working days without wage contributes on the full monthly wage of the labour contract, the wage of the unpaid days is added back to the base.
